taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller op amp using Sky130 1.8 V MOS devices and ideal R/C.
* Bench pushes 50 uA from vdd into iref; NMOS diode XMB is the mirror master.
* Stage 2 is a cascoded common-source for DC gain; Miller Cc + nulling Rz.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- bias mirror (master 50 uA), all NMOS mirror devices L=1.4 ----
XMB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=56 nf=4
* ---- stage 1: NMOS-lvt diff pair, PMOS-lvt mirror load, 60 uA tail ----
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=67.2 nf=4
XM1 d1   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=48 nf=4
XM2 out1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=48 nf=4
XM3 d1   d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2
XM4 out1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2
* ---- stage 2: cascoded PMOS-lvt common source, cascoded 140 uA NMOS sink ----
XM6  x6   out1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=74.7 nf=8
XMC6 vout pbias x6 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=180 nf=18
XM7  x7   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=156.8 nf=8
XMC7 vout vbcn x7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=156.8 nf=8
* ---- cascode gate bias branches (15 uA each) ----
XMT2 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=16.8 nf=2
XMD  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMP8 vbcn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMDN vbcn vbcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.7 nf=1
CBP pbias vdd 1p
CBN vbcn vss 1p
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
RZ out1 zmid 2.2k
CC zmid vout 2.4p
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller op amp, Sky130 1.8 V devices.
* Stage 1: folded cascode - NMOS-LVT pair (M1/M2) folded into PMOS-LVT
*   sources (M8/M9) + cascodes (M10/M11), wide-swing NMOS mirror (M12-M15).
* Stage 2: NMOS-LVT common source (M6) with PMOS-LVT current-source load (M16).
* Compensation: Rz + Cc from stage-1 output (n1) to vout.
* Bias: bench pushes 50 uA into iref; NMOS diode MB1 masters all mirrors.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Bias distribution (NMOS std mirrors, L=1) ----
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=6
* Tail: ~25 uA
XM5  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=3
* Branch sinks ~10.4 uA each
XMB5 nb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMB6 nb4 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMB8 nb8 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* vbp master: PMOS-LVT diode at top-source current density
XMB2 nb1 nb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=33 nf=3
* vcp generator: headroom resistor + PMOS-LVT diode at cascode density
RB1  vdd nb3 36k
XMB3 nb4 nb4 nb3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=75 nf=6
* vcn generator: P mirror pushes ~10.4 uA into lifted NMOS-LVT diode
XMB7 nb5 nb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=33 nf=3
XMB4 nb5 nb5 nb6 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=75 nf=6
RB2  nb6 vss 24k
* vbp2 master for output-stage load, decoupled to vdd
XMB9 nb8 nb8 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=2
CB2  nb8 vdd 4p

* ---- Stage 1: folded cascode ----
XM1  fa vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=96 nf=12
XM2  fb vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=96 nf=12
* Top PMOS-LVT current sources, ~25 uA each
XM8  fa nb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=80 nf=8
XM9  fb nb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=80 nf=8
* PMOS-LVT cascodes
XM10 na nb4 fa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=90 nf=8
XM11 n1 nb4 fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=90 nf=8
* Wide-swing NMOS mirror: bottoms M12/M13, LVT cascodes M14/M15
XM12 sa na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24 nf=2
XM13 sb na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24 nf=2
XM14 na nb5 sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=90 nf=8
XM15 n1 nb5 sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=90 nf=8

* ---- Stage 2: NMOS-LVT common source + PMOS-LVT load, ~120 uA ----
XM6  vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=160 nf=16
XM16 vout nb8 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=184 nf=18

* ---- Miller compensation ----
RZ n1 nz 1.8k
CC nz vout 1.5p

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller op amp, Sky130 1.8 V MOS devices with ideal R/C compensation.
*
* Stage 1: NMOS differential pair (M1/M2) with LVT-PMOS current-mirror load
*          (M3/M4) and NMOS tail sink (M5).
* Stage 2: LVT-PMOS common-source driver (M6) with NMOS current-sink load (M7).
* Compensation: Miller capacitor CC with series nulling resistor RZ. RZ is
*          larger than 1/gm6, so it places a left-half-plane zero that adds
*          phase lead near the unity-gain frequency.
* Bias: the 50 uA reference sunk into iref drives diode XMB. M5 and M7 mirror
*          it at a matched current density: tail ~40 uA, second stage ~160 uA.
*
* PMOS devices use the LVT flavour: in this model set the standard
* pfet_01v8 |Vth| is about 1 V, which leaves no headroom at the 1.62 V supply.
* Long-channel bias devices (L=6) raise the output resistance of the tail and
* sink. M6 current density matches M4, so the first stage stays balanced
* (low systematic offset).
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Reference diode and NMOS current sinks (W/L ratio 1 : 0.8 : 3.2)
XMB  iref iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=120 nf=12
XM5  tail iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=96 nf=12
XM7  vout iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=384 nf=48
* Input pair (vinn drives the diode side, so it is the inverting input)
XM1  d1   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6
XM2  n1   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6
* PMOS mirror load
XM3  d1   d1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=2
XM4  n1   d1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=2
* Second-stage common-source driver
XM6  vout n1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.25 w=80 nf=10
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ   n1   nz   2800
CC   nz   vout 2p
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller op amp, Sky130 1.8 V devices, current-biased from iref.
* Stage 1: NMOS differential pair with LVT PMOS mirror load.
* Stage 2: LVT PMOS common source with LVT PMOS cascode and cascoded NMOS sink.
* Compensation: Miller capacitor with series nulling resistor (LHP zero).
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Bias: the 50 uA iref flows through RN into the NMOS reference diode, so
* v(iref) = Vgs + 0.4 V serves as the NMOS output-cascode gate bias.
RN iref nref 8000
XMNR nref nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=80 nf=8
* Tail (40 uA), output sink (160 uA) and cascode-bias sink (5 uA)
XMN5 tail nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=64 nf=8
XMN7 x7 nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=256 nf=32
XMN7C vout iref x7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=8
XMNC vcp nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
* PMOS cascode gate: diode at the cascode's current density plus a 0.4 V
* drop across RC, which sets the output PMOS drain-source headroom.
XMPC pc pc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
RC pc vcp 80000
CB vcp vdd 2e-12
* Stage 1
XMN1 n1 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMN2 n2 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMP3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=36 nf=2
XMP4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=36 nf=2
* Stage 2 (XMP6 sized so its Vsg matches the stage-1 load, balancing n1/n2)
XMP6 x6 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=90 nf=9
XMP6C vout vcp x6 x6 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* Compensation
RZ n2 nz 3000
CC nz vout 1.5e-12
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated op amp in Sky130 1.8 V CMOS.
* Stage 1: telescopic-cascode: NMOS-LVT diff pair + NMOS-LVT cascodes under a
*          wide-swing cascoded PMOS-LVT mirror. All cascode biases are
*          vdd-referenced by one leg (R drop + PMOS diode) so margins track
*          PVT. Pair drains sit high, so input CM works to ~1.45 V at 1.62 V.
* Stage 2: PMOS-LVT common source + NMOS current-sink load.
* Compensation: Miller Cc with series Rz.
* Bias: NMOS diode at iref (bench pushes 50 uA in) mirrored to the tail, the
* output sink, and the cascode-bias leg.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* --- Bias mirrors ---
XMD iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
XMT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62 nf=10
XMTB vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
* Cascode-bias leg: vbn = vdd - I*RA biases the NMOS cascode gates; MB is
* density-matched to the PMOS cascodes so vbp = vbn - Vsg(MB) forces the
* mirror devices' Vsd to ~I*RA at every process/temperature corner.
RA vdd vbn 12k
XMB vbp vbp vbn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=84 nf=14

* --- Stage 1: telescopic cascode ---
XM1 nd1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=144 nf=24
XM2 nd2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=144 nf=24
XMC1 nx1 vbn nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=17
XMC2 nx2 vbn nd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=17
XM3 ns3 nx1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=160 nf=27
XM4 ns4 nx1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=160 nf=27
XMC3 nx1 vbp ns3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=240 nf=40
XMC4 nx2 vbp ns4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=240 nf=40

* --- Stage 2: common-source output ---
XM6 vout nx2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=300 nf=50
XM7 vout iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=110 nf=18

* --- Miller compensation ---
CC vout ncz 4p
RZ ncz nx2 1.5k

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Two-Stage Miller Op Amp: Gain 70 dB, UGB 20 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* Two-stage Miller-compensated operational amplifier -- Sky130 1.8 V core
* =====================================================================
* Topology
*   Stage 1 : NMOS differential pair (XM1/XM2) on an NMOS tail source,
*             loaded by a PMOS current mirror (XM3 diode / XM4 mirror).
*   Stage 2 : PMOS common-source XM6 against the NMOS sink XM7.
*   Comp.   : Miller capacitor CC from the stage-1 output n2 to vout, in
*             series with nulling resistor RZ.  RZ > 1/gm6, so the
*             right-half-plane zero is moved into the left half plane and
*             adds phase lead below the second pole.
*
* Biasing
*   The 50 uA forced into iref is sunk by the diode-connected XMB1 and
*   ratioed to the tail (XMTL) and to the output sink (XM7).  Every
*   internal current is therefore a pure geometric ratio of iref, so the
*   supply current -- and hence total power -- is essentially supply,
*   process and temperature independent.
*
* Supply / common-mode rejection
*   Both PSRR+ and CMRR of this stage reduce to gm1/(gds2-gds1): the
*   input devices unbalance the mirror only to the extent that their
*   drain voltages differ.  n1 and n2 are therefore forced to the same
*   potential by giving XM3/XM4 and XM6 the same channel length and the
*   same device type, and by sizing them in the ratio of the currents
*   they carry,
*        W6/W3 = I6/I3 = 2*W7/WT = 4.69 ,
*   which makes Vsg3 = Vsg6 identically at every PVT point.  The residual
*   n1-n2 offset stays below 7 mV over all corners; that lifts PSRR+ and
*   CMRR by roughly 25 dB relative to an unmatched mirror and also nulls
*   the systematic input offset.
*
* Headroom notes
*   The NMOS pair keeps the tail node low (~0.2 V) so the tail device
*   stays saturated at 1.62 V / -40 C, and XM3/XM4/XM6 run at a small
*   overdrive so that n1/n2 sit high enough to keep XM1/XM2 saturated at
*   that same corner, which is the one that sets the worst-case DC gain.
* =====================================================================
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* --- current-mirror bias tree: 50 uA reference, tail, output sink ---
XMB1  iref   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=6
XMTL  ntail  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=29 nf=7
XM7   vout   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=68 nf=17

* --- differential input pair; vinn drives the diode side and vinp the
*     mirror side, which makes vinp the non-inverting input ---
XM1   n1     vinn   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=20
XM2   n2     vinp   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=20

* --- PMOS current-mirror load ---
XM3   n1     n1     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=58 nf=15
XM4   n2     n1     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=58 nf=15

* --- common-source output stage (W6/W3 = 4.69 sets Vsg6 = Vsg3) ---
XM6   vout   n2     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=272 nf=68

* --- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ---
CC    n2 nz 2.5p
RZ    nz vout 1200

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp, Sky130 1.8 V core devices.
*
* The continuous-variant model file used by the benches has |Vthp| ~ 1.06 V,
* so a PMOS input pair cannot be biased at the 0.9 V input common mode.
* Architecture:
*   XN0  : diode NMOS on iref, converts the external 50 uA pull-up into vbn
*   XPB/ : 25 uA branch that creates the PMOS gate bias vbp
*   XNB
*   XP5  : PMOS tail, 4x the bias branch (100 uA)
*   XN1/2: NMOS differential pair (vinn on diode-load side, vinp output side)
*   XP3/4: PMOS current-mirror load; d2 is the first-stage output
*   XN7  : NMOS common-source second stage
*   XP6  : PMOS active load of the second stage (3x the bias branch)
*   RC/CC: nulling resistor + Miller capacitor between d2 and vout
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Bias network ----
XN0   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=14 nf=2
XPB   vbp  vbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2   w=19 nf=2
XNB   vbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=7  nf=1

* ---- First stage ----
XP5   sx   vbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2   w=76 nf=4
XN1   d1   vinn sx  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10 nf=2
XN2   d2   vinp sx  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10 nf=2
XP3   d1   d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=28 nf=4
XP4   d2   d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=28 nf=4

* ---- Second stage ----
XN7   vout d2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=14 nf=2
XP6   vout vbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2   w=57 nf=3

* ---- Startup aid ----
* sx=vdd with tail and pair both off is a stable degenerate DC solution; in
* in it vout sits low (~0 V, vinn low), while healthy vout ~0.9 V.
* RST defines the latched d1 level; the skewed inverter (trip ~0.7 V)
* drives gx high only in the low-output latch so XST pulls sx down.
* Healthy gx=0, so the startup network draws no signal current.
RST   d1  vdd  1meg
XIPG  gx  vout vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10   nf=2
XING  gx  vout vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=0.42 nf=1
XST   sx  gx   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2    nf=1

* ---- Miller compensation ----
RC    d2 vgz 2.4k
CC    vgz vout 2.5p

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp (Sky130 1.8 V core devices).
*
* Bias: the external source INJECTS 50 u into iref, so the reference diode
* is NMOS MNREF to vss (Nbias). MNBR mirrors Nbias into the PMOS diode
* MPREF, whose gate (Pbias) drives the PMOS tail and second-stage load.
*
* Signal path: PMOS tail MP5 -> NMOS input pair MN1/MN2 -> NMOS mirror
* loads MN3/MN4 -> NMOS common-source MN6 with PMOS load MP7.
* Miller Cc with nulling resistor Rz between v1 and vout.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* --- Nbias reference diode (50 u) ---
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* --- Nbias -> Pbias generator branch (1x = 50 u) ---
XMNBR  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMPREF pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* --- first-stage PMOS tail: 1x = 50 u total ---
XMP5   nsrc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* --- NMOS differential input pair (25 u each) ---
XMN1   nd1 vinn nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN2   nd2 vinp nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* --- NMOS current-mirror loads (25 u each) ---
XMN3   nd1 nd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMN4   nd2 nd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* --- second stage NMOS CS: 4x load width => 100 u at Vgs=Vgs3 ---
XMN6   vout nd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* --- second-stage PMOS load: 2x Pbias mirror = 100 u ---
XMP7   vout pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* --- latch kickers: opposing LVT diodes between mirror sides.
* Off for small differential signal swings; turn on for the large node
* separation of a saturated DC latch and restore balance. ---
XK1    nd1 vdd nd2 nd2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XK2    nd2 vdd nd1 nd1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* --- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ---
CC     nr  vout 1.4p
RZ     nd2 nr   1.3k
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* pbias2 quiet PMOS gate bias for MP2
* ntail  diff-pair common source

* n1b    stage-1 output (vinp) -> M2 gate
* n1z    Miller R/C junction

XMPd pbias2 pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  w=25 l=1.5 nf=3

XM6  ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=40  l=3 nf=5
XM1n n1a vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=66  l=3 nf=8

XMP1b n1b n1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=120 l=1.5 nf=15
*

* M2 uses regular-threshold NMOS so its gate (n1b ~ Vth+Vov2 ~ 0.65 V)

XMP2 vout pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    w=400 l=2 nf=40

CC  n1z vout 3.0p

XMN3  n3d  nd   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=15 nf=1
XMN3C nd   vcasp n3d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=15 nf=1

circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated op amp, rail-to-rail complementary input, Sky130.
* Architecture:
*   NMOS-lvt pair (M1N/M2N) + PMOS-lvt pair (M1P/M2P) with fixed cascoded tails.
*   Cross-summed folded nodes: nP holds M1N drain + M2P drain, nN holds
*   M2N drain + M1P drain. PMOS fold devices inject If; cascoded NMOS mirrors
*   sink If + Id_cross - Id_same from nP/nN.
*   Sum node n1 is sourced by the mirror copy of the nP current plus a half
*   copy of the PMOS tail, and sinks the NMOS tail half copy. Because the tail
*   copies vanish when a pair dies, the n1 KCL identity holds at every common
*   mode: no dead zone over the full input range.
*   Second stage: NMOS common source (M6N) with cascoded PMOS load (M7P/M7PC)
*   for PSRR. Miller Cc with series Rz. All bias derives from the external
*   50 uA forced into iref.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* --- Bias generation ---
* iref pin sinks 50 uA through a diode-connected NMOS.
XMNB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=4
* Branch B: PMOS-lvt diode (pb1 = vdd - Vsg) and RB1 drop to pb2 (fold gates).
XMPB1 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=15 nf=3
RB1 pb1 pb2 7.5k
XMNB2 pb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
* PMOS cascode rails: pca ~ vdd-0.5, pbc ~ vdd-1.0 (two lvt diodes + sink).
XPE1 pca pca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XPE2 pbc pbc pca vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMNE pbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
* NMOS mirror cascode rail nbc ~ two lvt Vgs above vss.
XMPC nbc pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMNC2 nbc nbc ncm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNC1 ncm ncm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* NMOS tail cascode rail: nb1n diode, nb2n = nb1n + RND drop.
XMPD nb2n pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
RND nb2n nb1n 18k
XMND1 nb1n nb1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
*
* --- Input pairs ---
XM1N nP vinn ntn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XM2N nN vinp ntn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XM1P nN vinn ntp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XM2P nP vinp ntp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
*
* --- Tails (fixed, cascoded for CMRR) ---
XM5N nxn nb1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM5NC ntn nb2n nxn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM5P nxp pca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XM5PC ntp pb2 nxp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
*
* --- Fold sources (gate pb2): inject If into nP, nN, n1 ---
XFA nP pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XFB nN pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XFS n1 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
*

XM3NC nP nbc nbi vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM3N nbi nbi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM4NC n1 nbc nxi vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM4N nxi nbi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* nN local sink (diode + cascode), no copy.
XMND nN nbc nld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMLD nld nld vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
*
* --- Tail half copies at n1 (balance terms) ---
XMTP n1 pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XMTN n1 nb1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
*
* --- Second stage: NMOS CS, cascoded PMOS load ---
XM6N vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XM7P n7x pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=7 nf=2
XM7PC vout pca n7x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
*
* --- Miller compensation ---
RZ n1 nz 1.5k
CC nz vout 1.1p
CN1 n1 vss 0.15p
*
* --- Convergence aids (negligible current) ---
RNB n1 vss 3meg
RNT ntn vss 5meg
RNP ntp vdd 5meg
*
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

* Parallel NMOS and PMOS differential pairs keep the input stage active
* over the full common-mode range (0.3-1.5 V) and across all corners:
* at cold/ss corners the PMOS pair cuts off and the NMOS pair carries the
* signal; at low CM the NMOS pair cuts off and the PMOS pair carries it.
* Mirror loads sum both pair currents into one first-stage output node D1,
* which drives an NMOS common-source second stage with a long-L PMOS
* current-source load. Miller compensation Cc + Rz (LHP zero).
* Bias is generated from the external iref (50 uA) reference.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- Bias network --------------------------------------------------------
* N0 diode sets nb. AUX/AUX2 sink scaled currents through P1 (L=1) and
* P2 (L=3) diodes, generating supply-tracking pb and pb2 gate biases.
XN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=13.1 nf=2
XAUX pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2.62 nf=1
XP1 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25.6 nf=4

XP2 pb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=34.2 nf=6
CPB pb vss 2p
CPB2 pb2 vss 2p
* ---- Tail current sources ------------------------------------------------
XTAILN csn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=15.72 nf=3
XTAILP csp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=76.8 nf=12
* ---- NMOS input pair with PMOS mirror load -------------------------------
* N1 (vinp side) drain goes to the summing node D1; N2 (vinn side) drain
* hosts the PMOS mirror diode (x2).
XN1 d1 vinp csn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=15.8 nf=3
XN2 x2 vinn csn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=15.8 nf=3

XPB y2 vinn csp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=32 nf=5

XM7 vout pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=476 nf=68
